business_model.first_revenue_motion: Paid reviewer proof sprint or paid replay-scope package.
business_model.funding_motion: SBIR, RFI/BAA response, grants, in-kind engineering, venture diligence, and strategic partner routes.
business_model.pricing_rule: Human quotes only after scope, data boundary, authority, and deliverables are reviewed.
business_model.second_revenue_motion: Pilot intake and partner diligence room for a named validation path.
business_model.third_revenue_motion: Recurring proof portal, dashboard, and packet refresh access after setup.

buyer_proof_checklist: Named customer segment and buyer role
Problem tied to a deadline, decision, or reviewer burden
First paid offer with a bounded deliverable
Evidence artifact that proves the packet exists
Human approval gate for send, submit, schedule, terms, and access
No unearned customer result or award language
Source-count and current-measurement posture visible to reviewer
Next decision phrased as a low-friction funded sprint or pilot-scope step

customer_cards.buyer_role: Program lead, technical evaluator, contracting specialist, or SBIR topic reviewer
customer_cards.decision_trigger: A live opportunity, RFI, SBIR topic, BAA call, or agency meeting creates a deadline.
customer_cards.first_offer: Submission preparation and reviewer proof packet
customer_cards.job_to_be_done: Decide whether LumenCore is credible enough to fund, invite, or route to a pilot path.
customer_cards.name: Agency program or SBIR reviewer
customer_cards.pain: Advanced claims arrive faster than a reviewer can verify source, boundary, and repeatability.
customer_cards.proof_needed: Source-backed packet, official-opportunity fit, human authority gates, and a clear no-final-action boundary.

customer_cards.buyer_role: Data owner, lab lead, platform engineer, or applied AI reviewer
customer_cards.decision_trigger: A partner needs to know what data, metric, and baseline would make a pilot defensible.
customer_cards.first_offer: Paid evidence review and replay-scope sprint
customer_cards.job_to_be_done: Convert a complex model or proof stack into a repeatable validation receipt.
customer_cards.name: Technical validation owner
customer_cards.pain: Manual review is slow when source freshness, baselines, metrics, and replay receipts are scattered.
customer_cards.proof_needed: Measured-source register, replay runner scope, baseline lock, and hash-backed receipt plan.

customer_cards.buyer_role: Venture studio partner, early investor, accelerator reviewer, or technical diligence lead
customer_cards.decision_trigger: A diligence call asks for the business model, first customer, and near-term revenue motion.
customer_cards.job_to_be_done: See whether the company can turn evidence into funded work without unsupported promises.
customer_cards.name: Venture builder or investor
customer_cards.pain: Diligence slows down when technical excitement is not paired with a buyer path and claim controls.
customer_cards.proof_needed: Customer segments, productized offers, traction lanes, data-room map, and blocked-claim policy.

customer_cards.buyer_role: University lab, enterprise innovation team, infrastructure operator, or qualified prime
customer_cards.decision_trigger: The partner has a problem area and needs a controlled way to test fit.
customer_cards.job_to_be_done: Start a bounded study without exposing private data or accepting broad terms too early.
customer_cards.name: Pilot partner
customer_cards.pain: Partners need the work scoped before they can share data, assign reviewers, or commit budget.
customer_cards.proof_needed: Pilot intake path, human approvals, data boundary, acceptance standard, and review artifacts.

customer_cards.buyer_role: Patent counsel, compliance lead, or governance reviewer
customer_cards.decision_trigger: A filing, investor review, public packet, or agency account step approaches.
customer_cards.job_to_be_done: Separate defensible claims from language that needs counsel, agency, or security review.
customer_cards.name: IP or compliance reviewer
customer_cards.pain: Public materials can drift into overclaiming unless every claim has an owner and evidence boundary.
customer_cards.proof_needed: IP diligence packet, federal protocol packet, authority matrix, and public-safe data-room manifest.

executive_summary: LumenCore sells proof-to-pilot infrastructure for reviewers who need complex R&D translated into inspectable, source-backed, human-gated decision material. The first money motion is a paid proof or replay-scope sprint; the expansion path is pilot support, agency submission preparation, partner diligence rooms, and eventually recurring proof portal access.
fastest_funding_path: Use the executive summary to anchor the buyer and business model.
Offer a paid reviewer proof sprint or replay-scope package as the first concrete purchase.
Route agencies through official-source submission preparation with final action blocked until human approval.
Route investors and venture builders to the 30-day technical and commercialization sprint.
Route pilot partners to a data-boundary and acceptance-standard discussion before any private data exchange.

human_gate.rule: This packet prepares the business-side answer. Robert approves any send, schedule, terms, price, file share, or portal action.

offers.buyer: Agency, SBIR, investor, or partner reviewer
offers.deliverable: Proof-card index, source register, decision brief, reviewer Q&A, and claim-boundary map.
offers.name: Reviewer proof sprint
offers.price_posture: Quoted after scope; no fixed price promise in this packet.
offers.success_gate: Reviewer can answer what is ready, what is blocked, and what decision is being requested.

offers.buyer: Technical validation owner or data owner
offers.deliverable: Baseline, metric, holdout window, data boundary, replay receipt schema, and dry-run report.
offers.name: Paid replay-scope package
offers.price_posture: Quoted after data and acceptance criteria are reviewed.
offers.success_gate: Buyer knows what evidence would support a paid validation study.

offers.buyer: Founder, prime, partner team, or grant reviewer
offers.deliverable: Opportunity fit matrix, official-source checklist, technical volume outline, and final-action docket.
offers.name: Agency submission preparation package
offers.price_posture: Quoted after portal, eligibility, reps/certs, and attachment requirements are verified.
offers.success_gate: Human has a clean package ready for final portal review and submission authority.

offers.buyer: Investor, partner, or internal reviewer team
offers.deliverable: Dashboard JSON, proof-room navigation, source freshness, packet refreshes, and evidence receipts.
offers.duration: Monthly or sprint-retainer after a paid setup
offers.name: Proof portal and dashboard subscription
offers.price_posture: Post-pilot subscription; not quoted before a buyer-specific scope.
offers.success_gate: Reviewer has a repeatable portal for source-backed updates and diligence refreshes.

offers.buyer: Qualified prime, venture builder, lab, or strategic partner
offers.deliverable: Data-room manifest, claim controls, technical scope, customer path, and partner-only action list.
offers.name: Partner diligence room
offers.price_posture: Quoted after partner role, data boundary, and deliverable ownership are clear.
offers.success_gate: Partner can decide whether to intro, team, sponsor, or fund the next scoped sprint.
